parsed_json.up: Select distinct molecules from document CHEMBL1123873. Join docs by chembl_id to get doc_id, then compound_records by doc_id to get molregno and compound_name, then molecule_dictionary by molregno to get chembl_id, then compound_structures by molregno (inner join) to get canonical_smiles. Filter to rows where canonical_smiles is not null. Return chembl_id, compound_name, canonical_smiles. Sort by chembl_id, compound_name, canonical_smiles.
